journey.name: Try It AI-locked routes to Settings
journey.description: Verifies that the Try It tab shows the AI-locked empty state when no API key is configured, and that its call-to-action navigates to Settings. Start state: fresh install with no API key configured.

actions.action: Tap the "TRY IT" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Try It screen shows the locked state: the "AI powered analysis" title and a "Connect Claude AI" button.
Verify the app navigates to the Settings screen, showing the "Settings" heading and the "Claude API Key" row.
